question: Kakuzi Limited parent company owner
markdown:
Kakuzi Limited (Kakuzi PLC) is a Kenyan agricultural company
. Its ultimate parent company and majority owner is
Camellia PLC
, a UK-based international investment and holding group listed on the London Stock Exchange.
Wikipedia
Ownership Structure
Parent Company:
Camellia PLC (via subsidiaries including Bordure Limited and Lintak Investments Limited).
Controlling Stake:
Camellia PLC holds an effective majority control of roughly 50.7% in Kakuzi PLC.
Other Major Shareholders:
Kenyan investor John Kibunga Kimani holds a substantial individual stake (around 27.7%), with the remaining shares split among various public investors on the Nairobi Securities Exchange and London Stock Exchange.
